scope: Renew the OKHP3 Skill Foundry portable package, record the evidence and limitations, then synchronize authorized mirrors.

evidence_sources.title: Agent Skills Specification
evidence_sources.claim_used: Portable metadata, naming, progressive-disclosure, and resource-layout constraints.

evidence_sources.title: OpenAI Learn: Build Skills
evidence_sources.claim_used: Front-loaded descriptions and optional host adapter guidance.

evidence_sources.title: Anthropic: Equipping agents for the real world with Agent Skills
evidence_sources.claim_used: Progressive disclosure as a design pattern.

evidence_sources.title: GitHub Copilot: About agent skills
evidence_sources.claim_used: Cross-client locations and package portability considerations.

evidence_sources.title: Prompt Equilibrium framework attachments supplied by the package owner
evidence_sources.claim_used: Conditional dissent, explicit roles, provenance ledgers, semantic-interference awareness, and evidence-based reconciliation.
limitations: Attachment claims and citations were not adopted as current normative platform facts without separate verification.
The equilibrium metaphor is not asserted to be a formal game-theoretic solution.

review_passes.finding: Make portable constraints explicit, preserve optional adapters, use frozen evaluation protocols, and renew on evidence-changing events.
Fail zero-package validation, retire exposed holdouts, preserve legacy benchmark status, and use non-compensatory critical-risk gates.
Synchronize a reviewed package inventory rather than SKILL.md alone and retain local workspace evidence without blind overwrite.
Agreement should trigger falsification; material disagreement should trigger evidence negotiation rather than a vote or ritualized dissent.

changes.hypothesis: A compact portable core with explicit evidence and trust boundaries is more reliable than a long, self-certifying instruction set.
changes.expected_benefit: More precise activation, safer execution, and version-specific claims.
changes.regression_risk: Added structure could burden low-risk work.
changes.mitigation: Use the equilibrium protocol only for material decisions and preserve a lightweight default path.
changes.result: Analytical review accepted; live 3.0.0 benchmark not run.
changes.applicability_limit: No performance claim without fresh, comparable executions.

changes.hypothesis: Conditional dissent reduces the risk of consensus becoming self-certification.
changes.expected_benefit: An evidence-backed path for adversarial counterexamples and disagreement resolution.
changes.regression_risk: Correlated reviewers or performative contrarianism could waste effort.
changes.mitigation: Record reviewer dependence and require falsifiable counterexamples; allow defer-for-evidence.
changes.result: Design and development evaluation case added; no live release evidence claimed.
changes.applicability_limit: Independent contexts and, where possible, models are needed for stronger evidence.

rejected_alternatives.alternative: Treat any repeated agreement as proof the Foundry is perfect.
rejected_alternatives.reason: Agreement can arise from shared context, model behavior, source gaps, or an untested assumption.

rejected_alternatives.alternative: Run a contrarian on every minor formatting change.
rejected_alternatives.reason: Cost must be proportional to risk; low-risk work needs ordinary review.
